name: blog-notebooklm
description: > Query a user's Gemini Notebook (formerly NotebookLM) for source-grounded answers through a logged-in browser session on their Google account. Uses the account's usage limits and writes browser state. Runs only on an explicit request: /blog notebooklm, "ask my Gemini Notebook", "ask my NotebookLM notebook", or "query my notebook library". Also used by blog-write when the user named a notebook for research. Not for generic research or note-taking.
author: AgriciDaniel
